sections.heading: Ajay Singh Chautala — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ajay Singh Chautala was born on 13 March 1961 in Sirsa District, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Om Prakash Chautala.
He studied at Kurukshetra University, University of Rajasthan and Dayanand college, Hisar.

sections.heading: Ajay Singh Chautala — Career and Professional Work
paras: Ajay Singh Chautala works primarily as a politician.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha, Member of the Haryana Legislative Assembly and Member of the 13th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Indian National Lok Dal.

sections.heading: Ajay Singh Chautala — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He is married to Naina Singh Chautala.
He is a parent to Dushyant Chautala and Digvijay Chautala.
